15.correctFeedback: Use impairment/distress criteria; resist viral overpathologizing (§15.1–15.2; personality; social media).

wrongFeedback.2: People who pick this collapse introversion into disorder.

wrongFeedback.2: People who pick this deny operant maintenance after classical acquisition.
